correctness.rationale: For isotropic M=σ[I_r 0], at every reached rank k with fresh Gaussian block b, residual X~χ²_{b(r-k)} and captured Y~χ²_{bk} are independent conditionally on full past. Therefore P(stop|reached k)=I_tau(b(r-k)/2,bk/2) and the finite stopping mass is p_j∏(1-p_i). True squared relative Frobenius error equals (r-k)/r. Chernoff entropy tail nD(u||tau), n=br/2, and uniform one-sided beta Laplace tail with u=tau+c sqrt(log r/r) produce exponent bc²/[4tau(1-tau)], with ~sqrt(r/logr) effectively competing k. This yields c*=sqrt(2tau(1-tau)/b) in probability and false tolerance acceptance tending 1. Independently checked integer beta/binomial identity and the r=2048 b=2 tau=1/4 false-stop probability 0.987911365509179. Fresh batches, fixed b, r multiple b, tau∈(0,1) essential; no claims for practical averaged-denominator HSS pipeline.
